analyze: Configure code analysis, run analyzers, and resolve findings.
audio-notes: Research, plan, document, and implement audio-note work.
bugs: Collect, investigate, plan, and fix tracked bugs.
build-and-upload: Set up project build and upload tooling.
convention: Check changed code against project conventions.
debug: Create a debug build or version of an application.
deploy: Set up FTP deployment and watcher tooling.
docs: Create, generate, and update project documentation.
dry: Check changed code for avoidable duplication.
environment: Check that the development environment meets project needs.
features: Collect, plan, and implement tracked feature requests.
feedback: Write or implement feedback shared between related projects.
flutter: Check local Flutter dependencies and update Flutter packages.
ftp: Set up FTP backups with mirrored downloads and zip revisions.
git: Commit changes, configure Git, and handle repository maintenance.
github: Set up GitHub repositories, releases, and release workflows.
handoff: Create or continue a handoff for work that spans sessions.
insights: Analyze usage reports and plan command improvements.
issue: Turn an issue list entry into a planned implementation todo.
media: Create or update application icons and related tooling.
migrate: Plan and carry out dependency migrations incrementally.
php: Implement OpenAPI support and update PHP dependencies.
plan: Create, review, split, save, and implement project plans.
python: Upgrade Python projects to use uv.
refactor: Plan and carry out code refactoring in phases.
release: Set up releases, prepare release notes, and publish builds.
setting: Install a project setting from the shared repository.
tdd: Fix bugs by writing a failing test before changing code.
testing: Run tests and set up repeatable test checks.
tools: Automate browser navigation, interaction, screenshots, and checks.
translations: Set up translation tooling and refresh stale translations.
validate: Run the configured checks before committing changes.
verify: Verify code changes with tests and analysis.
